newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo gold futures end down but off early lows.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo gold futures end down but off early lows.

text.p: Yen-based Tokyo gold futures ended lower on Friday, reflecting bullion price declines overnight, traders said.
However, they came off early lows, supported by bargain-hunting from individual investors.

Gold prices ranged from five yen to nine yen per gram lower, with benchmark October 1997 gold ending five yen weaker at 1,337 yen, recovering from a seven-week low of 1,332 yen marked earlier in the day. In the bullion market, spot gold was a shade firmer, quoted at $376.65/95 per ounce at the Tokyo close, against $376.30/80 in New York on Thursday.
